# HuffPost

> > HuffPost is a progressive news and opinion platform covering breaking political news, international relations, lifestyle trends, and cultural phenomena.

Founded as The Huffington Post, HuffPost delivers comprehensive coverage of U.S. politics (particularly the Trump administration), global conflicts (Iran, Middle East), and viral cultural stories. The site combines hard news reporting with lifestyle content, explainers, and human interest pieces.

## Key Topics

- Donald Trump
- Trump Administration
- U.S. Politics
- Breaking News
- Pete Hegseth
- International Relations
- Iran Conflict
- Vladimir Putin
- Military News
- Current Events
- Lifestyle & Culture
- New York City
- Congressional Oversight
- Middle East Politics

## Essential

- [HuffPost - Breaking News, Politics, Entertainment & Opinion](https://www.huffpost.com/): Homepage featuring breaking news on Trump, Putin, and current politics

## Politics & Government

- [Police Officers, Sheriffs, Rangers, and Marshals: What's the Difference? | HuffPost Latest News](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/police-officers-sheriffs_b_7835320): Explainer on differences between law enforcement roles like Texas Rangers

## Lifestyle & Culture

- [11 Beautiful Italian Words And Phrases That Just Don't Translate | HuffPost Life](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/italian-words-we-dont-have-in-english_n_8280694): Lifestyle piece on untranslatable Italian language phrases and culture
- [Why Is It Called A 'Pet Peeve'? | HuffPost Life](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/why-called-pet-peeve_l_5c7fe7ebe4b0e62f69e8b795): Etymology article explaining the origin of the phrase 'pet peeve'

## Viral & Weird News

- [Longest YouTube Video Ever: 571 Hours And 101 Seconds (VIDEO) | HuffPost Weird News](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/longest-youtube-video-ever_n_910012): Article on Jonathan Harchick's 571-hour YouTube world record video
